description: Storm Drain Fee is a dataset listed in Metropolitan Transportation Commission open data portal (data.bayareametro.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Metropolitan Transportation Commission. Storm drain fee payment information, gathered from historical storm drain fee logbooks (2 sets each of pre- and post- 1977 payments). Additional information gathered from historical Microfilm files, Laserfiche Tract and Parcel Maps, and Miscellaneous Building Permits (file 50605.1). Coverage: San Francisco Bay Area. The table has 31 columns. The portal shows 2023-03-19 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bayareametro-gov-portal.
